# Stellar standards map — SEPs, CAPs and ecosystem references

Curated by Skill Harbor — Stellar's official standards skill: a routing map for the Stellar ecosystem — which SEP/CAP applies to what (SEP-41 token interface, SEP-7/SEP-10 frontend flows, anchors, federation, KYC, deposits and withdrawals), bundled ecosystem references (DeFi protocols, wallets, dev tools, indexers, bridges, funding programs), curated docs links and live MCP tooling references such as Raven. Honest caveats: the skill itself says standards status changes fast — it is a routing map, not governance truth; verify current SEP/CAP status against the official repos before implementing.
